description.narrative: (USAID Regional Development Mission-Asia (RDM/A)): The Advanced Energy Partnership for Asia ("The Partnership") supports USAID's Asia Enhancing Development and Growth through Energy (Asia EDGE) initiative through the provision of U.S. technical leadership, expertise, and experience in advanced energy sector technologies and practices. The Partnership is an interagency agreement between USAID/RDMA and the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE's) national laboratories, led by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL). .USAID/RDMA will use FY 2021 funds to continue supporting activities under the Partnership focusing on the development and deployment of tools, state-of-the-art approaches, and technical assistance to scale up advanced energy systems. The Partnership concentrates on key opportunities within partner countries, such as:.Utility performance: Improving energy utility planning and operational practices to increase efficiency and deploy advanced energy systems..A level playing field: Assisting governments in fostering supportive policy, legal and regulatory environments for private sector deployment and investment in clean energy systems..Data-driven decision-making: Increasing the availability and use of high-quality data to drive energy sector analysis and decision-making..Regional integration: Advancing regional energy system planning and operation practices to promote efficient and flexible cross-border energy trade..
